references.text: The next verse explains what the priest should do when he sees the white spots (בֶּהָרֹת לְבָנֹת) mentioned in verse 38, and gives the diagnosis that it is a harmless rash (בֹּהַק).
The introduction to the laws concerning skin diseases, where similar terms about swellings and spots on the skin are used (שְׂאֵת אֽוֹ־סַפַּחַת אֽוֹ בַהֶרֶת).
Summary of the laws concerning skin diseases that includes בֶּהָרֶת (spots), the same term used in 13:38.
Miriam was struck with leprosy and became white as snow (מְצֹרַעַת כַּשָּׁלֶג), an illustration of white skin spots as a skin disease.
